notes.title: Pipe Dreams was rated as Positive!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Pipe Dreams just got rated as Positive by steam!
Thank you for everyone that is playing and that made a review, I'm really happy that Pipe Dreams got over 10 reviews in just 2 days!

I'm planning some updates and new things for the game, I will be posting when and what will be coming soon!

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: Pipe Dreams is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm happy to announce that Pipe Dreams is now available on Steam!
I hope you enjoy the game and don't forget to leave a comment or review!

Have fun!

Note: There was some small errors on the first released version, but everything has been fixed, if anything just reinstall the game and it will work!
